user_statement: Tuscarora - suggested USFS data looks good. All your other suggestions look good. For the Access holds -- let's assume trails are open unless we have evidence to the contrary, so approve the vast majority of these. Exceptions: High Knob Loop looks like it's redundant with a road, reject that one. Cascades Overlook is too short to be interesting -- reject trails that are shorter than 0.1 miles if they don't connect any other useful geometry.
scope: The 168 access-hold records in this exception round; previous 967 accepted additions remain unchanged.
